title: Garment and design image catalogue
status: Implemented: 150 original SVG illustrations; see DESIGN-LIBRARY-IMPLEMENTATION.md for release verification.
scope: Garment types and design details for women, men and children; expandable through shop-owned uploads
note: This is a proposed coverage baseline, not an exhaustive fashion taxonomy or a collection of sewing patterns. Front/back views can require multiple image files per entry. Categories are navigation aids; a garment may receive additional audience tags. Compatibility must be specified per garment, not inferred from every combination.
